SometimesTomorrow · Memorial Keepsakes

Planners & keepsakes made to be kept, not filed away.

Every family deserves a plan their loved ones can actually find. My final wishes planners, funeral planning binders, and estate planning organizers gather the details that matter — funeral wishes, accounts, documents, and the stories behind them — in one beautiful place. Each piece comes in four matching color editions: Signature Navy & Gold, Cream & Gold, Rose Gold Blush, and Warm Wood.

I'm Christopher M. Spruell, a Las Vegas final expense broker. I lost my wife, my dad, and my brother — none of them had a plan written down. These are the tools I wish someone had handed me, sold through my Etsy shop, SometimesTomorrow.

How ordering works

1. Pick your piece here

2. Check out securely on Etsy

Etsy handles payment and buyer protection. I read every order myself.

3. It arrives your way

Downloads are instant; printed pieces are made to order and shipped to you, free in the US.

  • Digital planners & kits: instant download from Etsy. On listings with a language choice, the download explains the choice and your full English or Español edition arrives by Etsy Messages.
  • Printed stationery & prayer cards: printed to order and shipped in 5–7 business days, free US shipping. The stationery package always starts with a proof for your approval before anything prints.
  • Pet memorial journals & the gift box: printed to order and shipped in 5–7 business days, free US shipping.
  • Legacy binders: preorder — made to order in 2–3 weeks, free US shipping. Order before you need it.
  • Estate Documents Portfolio: engraved to order and shipped in 3–5 business days, free US shipping.
  • Returns: 30-day returns on shop items (you cover return shipping). Personalized pieces are made for one family — and if anything arrives wrong, I make it right.

Shop Questions

Questions about the shop

How long does the Legacy binder take?

It is a preorder: each binder is made to order, which takes 2–3 weeks, then it ships free in the US. It is a keepsake piece, made one at a time — order it before you need it, not during the week you do.

Can I send the Pet Loss Gift Box straight to someone else?

Yes — ship it to their address at Etsy checkout and add your gift message; it is printed on the gift note card inside the set. The box holds the personalized journal, a sympathy card, and four comfort cards.

How does the language choice work on the digital planners?

Pick English or Español on the Etsy listing. The instant download explains the choice, and your full edition — only the one language you picked — arrives by Etsy Messages.

Do the digital planners work on a tablet or phone?

Yes. They are fillable PDFs in US Letter and A4 — type right into the fields on a computer or tablet, or print them and write by hand. Every download includes all four color editions.

What if something arrives wrong?

Tell me and I make it right — that is my promise, and I read every order myself. Shop items carry 30-day returns (you cover return shipping). You can also call me at (702) 347-4536.

Is the Will & Estate Prep Kit a legal document?

No. It is an organizer, not a will, a trust, or legal advice. It gathers your people, property, and wishes in one place so the conversation with an attorney is faster and cheaper — the legal documents themselves come from an attorney.
